name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by attending the Spa 24 Hours with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Liège, focusing on materials science and quality assurance. His career began with an internship at a local automotive manufacturer before transitioning to motorsport. Thierry joined Inter Europol Competition three years ago, quickly establishing himself as a detail-oriented and reliable member of the team.

Thierry's approach to quality control is meticulous. He believes in preventative measures and continuous improvement, always seeking ways to optimize processes and minimize errors. He is a strong advocate for data-driven decision-making and utilizes statistical analysis to identify potential issues. His loyalty and dedication to the team are unwavering, and he is known for his ability to troubleshoot complex problems under pressure.

What sets Thierry apart is his ability to anticipate potential failures before they occur. He has an innate understanding of how different components interact and can identify subtle signs of wear or stress. This has saved the team countless hours and resources, making him an invaluable asset.

physical.description: Thierry has a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.
